# Copilot instructions

Read and follow `AGENTS.md` at the repository root before writing code. It is the single source of rules for every agent working here (Claude, Codex and Copilot): the Next.js version notes, and the project's brand and UI rules (colour tokens, light and dark themes, type, buttons, fields, tabs, dialogs, motion, icons, writing) and its action-message pop-ups.

Don't restate or override those rules here; change `AGENTS.md` instead.
